study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the ATBC Study cohort
reason: The abstract analyzes incident prostate cancer overall in a prospective nested case-control sample. It does not report an aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: From the ATBC Study cohort of 29 133 Finnish men, 50-69 years old, we randomly selected 100 incident prostate cancer case patients and matched 200 control subjects.
estimate_classifications.reason: The serum alpha-tocopherol estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, with no aggressive subtype specified.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
